constraints.all_tenant_permissions: session.active_tenant_id must equal resource.tenant_id and membership must be active
constraints.corrective_action_owner: actor.user_id must equal corrective_actions.owner_user_id; this is not a tenant role
constraints.tenant_admin: may administer memberships and tenant settings but may not read incidents, health data, investigations, exports or audit content by default
constraints.platform_admin: may operate platform metadata only; no tenant business-data permission by default
constraints.platform_break_glass: requires active time-limited support grant, tenant approver, reason, separate audit event and field-minimized response
constraints.disabled_user: deny all requests and revoke or reject every existing session
constraints.anonymous_report: reporter identity is absent from business records; technical abuse-prevention data is separately retained
